STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast tray meal (airline-style), photographed from the front at a slight elevated angle, straight on to the tray.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The largest vessel is the white paper/composite plate holding toast, eggs and avocado, about 22 cm in diameter (area ~380 cm²). The cereal bowl on the right is about 17 cm across (area ~227 cm²). The small white dish holding peach is about 8 cm across (area ~50 cm²). The muffin sits on a small plate about 11 cm across.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Toast (one slice, golden)
- Two fried eggs
- Avocado slices (about half an avocado)
- Peach/mango pieces in a small bowl
- Blueberry muffin
- Granola/muesli cereal in a bowl
- Yogurt cup (small, about 125 g container, mostly sealed)
- Butter/jam portion (small, about 10 g)
- Coffee/latte (cup, ~250 ml, mostly liquid, counted as beverage, not in food total)
- Water glass (not counted)

STEP 4 - Area (of food-covered plate area):
- Toast: ~12% of plate area → 46 cm² x 1.2 cm = 55 ml x 0.3 (bread) → ~17 g
- Eggs (two): ~12% → 46 cm² x 1.5 cm = 69 ml x 0.95 → ~65 g
- Avocado: ~6% → 23 cm² x 1.5 cm = 35 ml x 0.9 (dense) → ~30 g of flesh, edible portion ~30 g
- Peach pieces (bowl ~50 cm², 2.5 cm deep): 125 ml x 0.6 → ~75 g
- Muffin: ~40 cm² footprint, 4 cm tall, ~100 ml x 0.35 (baked, airy) → ~45 g
- Granola in cereal bowl: ~60% of 227 cm² = 136 cm² x 1.5 cm = 204 ml x 0.45 (loose, airy) → ~90 g
- Yogurt cup: ~150 g container, ~125 g product
- Butter/jam: ~10 g

STEP 5-6 - Grams are as above, summed in Step 8.

STEP 7 - Energy (kcal/100 g):
- Toast (white bread, buttered-free): 265
- Fried eggs: 196
- Avocado: 160
- Canned peach/mango: 60
- Blueberry muffin: 350
- Granola with nuts/dried fruit: 450
- Plain yogurt: 60
- Butter/jam portion: 300 (butter-like ~717; jam ~250; averaged ~300 for 10 g)

Energy estimates:
- Toast 17 g → 45 kcal
- Eggs 65 g → 127 kcal
- Avocado 30 g → 48 kcal
- Peach 75 g → 45 kcal
- Muffin 45 g → 158 kcal
- Granola 90 g → 405 kcal
- Yogurt 125 g → 75 kcal
- Butter/jam 10 g → 30 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total food ~497 g, ~933 kcal. For a single breakfast tray with a full cereal bowl, two eggs, a muffin and fruit, this is plausible. The coffee and water add no food energy in this estimate (milk in latte would add roughly 50–100 kcal if included).
